selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species classification and rule out look-alike composites (e.g., chamomile) at a taxonomical level.
To detect subtle AI artifacts such as melting petal edges, inconsistent lighting, or texture smearing in the high-frequency details of the petals.
To ensure each flower head is a topologically closed object without bleeding into the background or other flowers, checking for edge definition issues.

focus_areas: Petal edge sharpness and separation from background
Texture consistency of the yellow disc florets
Lighting coherence across multiple flower heads
Absence of morphological anomalies in petal count or shape
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the boundaries between the white petals and the green background. AI generators often struggle with fine, high-contrast edges like thin white petals against dark backgrounds, leading to haloing or fusion. Also, verify if the 'granular' texture of the yellow center is genuinely structured or just noise masquerading as detail.
